title: Law Profile v0.1.0
description: Generation-provenance profile for a2-law documents (生成の来歴＝工程の属性): which template/playbook/process version produced the document, with which LLM (GV AIAction), which slot values filled it, and per-clause marks (generated / user_modified / user_added) with statutory grounds. The contract CONTENT stays in the Contract profile — a LawGenerationRecord references the contract-profile document by id (two-layer). Records are stored as a2-vault type-1 records VERBATIM, so all provenance is written at generation time. Shared types $ref Grand Vault v0.0.10.

ClauseMarkEnum.description: Per-clause provenance mark. generated = text as generated (template + LLM, unchanged since). user_modified = the user edited the generated text (set on re-import when the current text differs from generatedTextSha256; such clauses are EXCLUDED from automatic update candidates — proposal only). user_added = the clause did not come from generation.

LawClauseProvenance.description: Provenance of ONE clause of the generated document. clauseKey is the stable join key between this record, the docx bookmark anchor (a2c_<clauseKey>), and amendment-impact notices.

clauseKey.description: Stable key of the clause WITHIN this document (also the docx bookmark anchor name a2c_<clauseKey>). Not the display clause number — numbering shifts when optional clauses are dropped or clauses are inserted.

clauseTypeId.description: a2-law clause_types catalog id the clause was generated from (e.g. limitation_of_liability_and_force_majeure). Absent for user_added clauses.

originArticle.description: 由来条番号 — the clause number in the source template at generation time (e.g. 第20条). Display-only; the machine-stable key is clauseKey.

generatedTextSha256.description: sha256 (hex) of the clause text AS GENERATED. Re-import diffs the current clause text against this to set mark=user_modified. Absent for user_added clauses.

legalGrounds.description: 根拠法令条, transcribed from the playbook checkpoint grounds, in EXACTLY the label format a2-law amendment-impact matching uses: '<法令タイトル> 第N条' optionally extended with '/第M項' (e.g. '個人情報の保護に関する法律 第27条'). Keeping this format means the existing impact matcher works on law-profile documents unchanged.

LawGenerationRecord.description: The generation-provenance record of ONE generated document (one a2-vault type-1 record). Written in full at generation time (a2-vault stores records verbatim and never adds fields). Identity vs integrity are SEPARATE on purpose: documentId (uuidv7) tracks the same document across byte changes; content sha256 (kept by the version ledger / a2-sign sourceFile) detects tampering. Do not mix the two roles.

profileVersion.description: Version of this profile the record was written against (e.g. '0.1.0').

documentId.description: 同一性追跡用 id (uuidv7), minted at generation. Embedded in the docx custom XML part (/a2/law-profile.xml) and in the PDF/A-3 attached JSON, so an externally edited file can be re-imported to the right record.

recordId.description: a2-vault record id of THIS record. Required also in 個人保管 (personally kept) JSON: personal keeping means NO amendment notifications; bringing the PDF back (re-import by recordId) rejoins notifications.

contractDocumentRef.description: id reference to the contract-profile document holding the CONTENT (two-layer: law profile = provenance, contract profile = content).

matterId.description: a2-law version-ledger (matter_event) matter id, when the document is tracked there.

versionId.description: matter_event version id of the generated output this record describes.

aiAction.description: LLM provenance — GV shared type reused as-is (modelName, modelVersion, provider, deploymentId, dataLineage, humanOversight …). Enables mechanical extraction of documents generated by an old model version.

processVersionId.description: a2-law process_version id (工程版) the generation ran under.

templateSha256.description: テンプレ版指紋 — sha256 (hex) of the a2-law template file (templates/<類型>.json) at generation time.

playbookSha256.description: 観点版指紋 — sha256 (hex) of the a2-law playbook file (playbook/<類型>.json) at generation time.

slots.description: スロット値一式 (slot id → confirmed value) as filled at compose time. This is the horizontal-reuse material: swap these values and regenerate for another counterparty / another product; only user_modified clauses need a carry-over confirmation.

clauses.description: Per-clause provenance marks, one entry per clause of the document.
